Card Q&A.a: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect include only either a card with the [Machine]/[Cyborg] trait or a black Tamer card, can I only add 1 card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect include both a card with the [Machine]/[Cyborg] trait and a black Tamer card, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Machine] or [Cyborg] trait and 1 black Tamer card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
Inherited Effect: ＜Reboot＞ (This Digimon also unsuspends during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
